messages:
kelly: Rainy Sunday recs thread! Looking for a movie + album combo to curl up with later. low energy, cozy, slightly weird. drop recs. ☕️
andre: Movie: 'The Station Agent' — slow and tender. Album: Nick Drake - Pink Moon. tiny, perfect.
nate: Movie: 'In the Mood for Love' for the mood. Album: Nat King Cole jazz for that late-night, rainy-window vibe.
sophia: Movie: 'Moon' (slow sci-fi) + Album: Nils Frahm piano looped. very meditative.
kelly: poll in emoji: 
  :one: = Station Agent + Pink Moon
  :two: = In the Mood for Love + Nat King Cole
  :three: = Moon + Nils Frahm
musicbot: quick playlists: https://open.spotify.example/playlist1 (folk), https://open.spotify.example/playlist2 (jazz), https://open.spotify.example/playlist3 (ambient piano)
andre: 👍 one from me. small songs while the movie breathes.
nate: two. moody color palette. also rec a short film "Raindrops Over Main" (10min) if anyone needs an opener.
sophia: three. piano makes the silence feel intentional.
kelly: tally: 1x, 2x, 1x — leaning two but will shuffle that jazz and Frahm between acts. thanks y'all.
andre: also: post-movie choccy and tea in kitchen? spontaneous!
kelly: yes 18:30 kitchen, bring mugs. GIF: (tiny mug cheers)
musicbot: event reminder: kitchen meetup 18:30 (auto-post).
